title: otter.ai/pricing.md
snippet:
> Otter.ai has four plans: Basic (free), Pro, Business, and Enterprise. All prices are in USD, per billed user.

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing | Max workspace size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | Free | Free | 5 members |
| Pro | $16.99/user/month | $8.33/user/month ($99.99/user/year) | 5 billed users |
| Business | $30/user/month | $19.99/user/month, billed annually | 25 billed users |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Contact sales | Unlimited |
## Basic plan (free)
For those who want to give it a try.
- Basic price: Free
- Basic max workspace size: 5 members
- Basic transcription: 300 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Basic max length per conversation: 30 minutes
- Basic file imports: 3 lifetime per user
- Basic concurrent meetings: 1
- Basic AI Chat: 20 queries per user per month (3 per conversation)
- Basic custom AI meeting templates: 5 meetings per user
- Basic conversation history: 25 most recent
- Basic custom vocabulary: 5 terms
- Basic exports: mp3, txt
- Basic Salesforce/HubSpot sync: not included
- Basic support: standard email support
- Basic features: joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet; live transcription; speaker identification; multi-language support; iOS and Android apps; Otter MCP server
## Pro plan
For individuals and small teams. Includes everything in Basic.
- Pro price: $16.99/user/month billed monthly, or $8.33/user/month billed annually ($99.99/user/year)
- Pro max workspace size: 5 billed users
- Pro transcription: 1,200 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Pro max length per conversation: 90 minutes
- Pro file imports: 10 per user per month
- Pro concurrent meetings: 2
- Pro AI Chat: 50 queries per user per month
- Pro custom AI meeting templates: 15 meetings per user
- Pro conversation history: unlimited
- Pro custom vocabulary: 100 names + 100 other terms per user, and the same per team
- Pro exports: mp3, txt, pdf, docx, srt
- Pro Salesforce/HubSpot sync: 1 user
- Pro support: standard email support
- Pro also includes: advanced AI meeting templates and workflows, unlimited storage, taggable speakers, advanced search, Zapier integration

Do you offer student discounts?
Yes, we offer a 20% discount on Otter Pro Monthly and Otter Pro Annual plans for **individual** students and teachers using an email address ending with **.edu**. The discounted prices are as follows:
Otter Pro Annual: $6.67 USD per month (billed $79.99 annually)
Otter Pro Monthly: $13.59 USD per month
